keyPoints.en: UMNO and the rulers' opposition forced the British to negotiate.
keyPoints.bm: Penentangan UMNO dan raja-raja memaksa British berunding.

keyPoints.en: Working Committee (British + rulers + UMNO) drafted the plan; a Consultative Committee gathered public views.
keyPoints.bm: Jawatankuasa Kerja (British + raja + UMNO) merangka rancangan; Jawatankuasa Perundingan mengumpul pandangan awam.

keyPoints.en: The Federation of Malaya began on 1 February 1948.
keyPoints.bm: Persekutuan Tanah Melayu bermula pada 1 Februari 1948.

keyPoints.en: Rulers' sovereignty restored; Conference of Rulers set up.
keyPoints.bm: Kedaulatan raja dikembalikan; Majlis Raja-Raja ditubuhkan.

keyPoints.en: Federal Legislative Council and Federal Executive Council.
keyPoints.bm: Majlis Perundangan Persekutuan dan Majlis Mesyuarat Kerajaan Persekutuan.

keyPoints.en: States: Menteri Besar; Penang and Melaka: Resident Commissioner.
keyPoints.bm: Negeri: Menteri Besar; Pulau Pinang dan Melaka: Pesuruhjaya Residen.

keyPoints.en: Stricter citizenship; Malay special rights protected.
keyPoints.bm: Kerakyatan lebih ketat; hak istimewa Melayu dilindungi.

tip.en: Compare with the Malayan Union point by point — a common SPM question.
tip.bm: Bandingkan dengan Malayan Union isi demi isi — soalan SPM yang kerap.

keyPoints.en: AMCJA (mainly non-Malay) + PUTERA (Malay left) opposed the plan.
keyPoints.bm: AMCJA (kebanyakannya bukan Melayu) + PUTERA (kiri Melayu) menentang rancangan itu.

keyPoints.en: They proposed the People's Constitution (1947) and held a hartal on 20 October 1947.
keyPoints.bm: Mereka mengemukakan Perlembagaan Rakyat (1947) dan mengadakan hartal pada 20 Oktober 1947.

keyPoints.en: The Federation became the base for the 1957 independence structure.
